record.dic_text:
985 blastano {blas-tan'-o}

源於 blastos (幼株); 動詞

欽定本 - spring up 2, bud 1, bring forth 1; 4

1) 發芽, 萌芽, 長出新枝 (#太13:26; 可4:27; 來9:4|)
2) 生出, 生產 (#雅5:18|)

985 blastano {blas-tan'-o}

from blastos (a sprout);; v

AV - spring up 2, bud 1, bring forth 1; 4

1) to sprout, bud, put forth new leaves
